problem: IndusCompute Hub, a fictional Indian GPU module assembly, advanced packaging and testing facility (it does not fabricate wafers), has 24,000 final-assembly and testing machine-hours available next month. It builds three product lines - AI accelerator modules, gaming GPU boards and edge GPU modules - each with a machine-hour cost, a contribution margin, a maximum demand and a minimum committed volume. It must decide how many units of each to build.
decision_question: How many units of each product should the hub manufacture? Explain the contribution margin, customer, strategic and resilience trade-offs.

roster.title: Market Research Agent
roster.mandate: Analyse demand, customer segments, competitive position and strategic account value across the product lines.

roster.title: Finance Agent
roster.mandate: Evaluate contribution margin, product-mix profitability and financial effect.

roster.title: Manufacturing Agent
roster.mandate: Own final-assembly and test capacity, the machine-hour budget, line balancing and the disruption buffer.

roster.title: Supply Chain Agent
roster.mandate: Component availability, procurement lead time and delivery risk for each line.

roster.title: Quality and Reliability Agent
roster.mandate: Yield, test escape rate, field-failure and reputational risk.

roster.title: Marketing and Sales Agent
roster.mandate: Customer commitments, minimum volumes, positioning and account relationships.

ceo.title: CEO Agent
ceo.objective: Balance contribution margin, customer commitments, bottleneck capacity, component availability, yield, quality, energy consumption, delivery risk and strategic customer value. A high-margin mix that breaks a customer commitment or the capacity buffer is not automatically the right mix.

guardrails: Do not invent semiconductor specifications. Treat all product and process values as synthetic planning data.
Do not claim a real process node, foundry relationship or benchmark result.

variables.note: final-assembly and testing hours next month
disruption buffer that should stay unused unless the CEO justifies otherwise
no single line may consume more than this share of total machine-hours

constraints.label: Total machine-hours used must leave the 1,200-hour disruption buffer
No product line may use more than 65% of total machine-hours
AI accelerator production cannot exceed maximum demand
Gaming board production cannot exceed maximum demand
Edge module production cannot exceed maximum demand
Must build at least the committed AI accelerator volume
Must build at least the committed gaming volume
Must build at least the committed edge volume

seed_strategies.name: Fill every line to maximum demand
